definitions.explanation: silently accepting or allowing something without explicit permission or objection

examples.japanese: ⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{黙認|もくにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黙認|もくにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was tacit consent from the supervisor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サービス{残業|ざんぎょう}→サービス残業：08477_saabisuzangyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{黙認|もくにん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company tacitly allows unpaid overtime.

notes:
{黙認|もくにん} means silently allowing or tolerating something — often questionable — without giving explicit approval ({黙|もく} silence + {認|にん} recognize/approve).

CONNOTATION: Usually negative; implies knowingly choosing not to act on wrongdoing, carrying responsibility without explicit approval.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黙認|もくにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / ⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to tacitly approve / to be tacitly permitted
- ⟦{事実上|じじつじょう}→事実上：11419_jijitsujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黙認|もくにん}: de facto approval

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {黙認|もくにん}: knowing and choosing not to object
- ⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧: explicit approval
- ⟦{看過|かんか}→看過：07978_kanka⟧: overlooking, more passive (may not have noticed)
- ⟦{容認|ようにん}→容認：12344_younin⟧: acceptance or tolerance, not necessarily silent

REGISTER: Formal; common in news, legal, and critical contexts.
